name: stv-video
description: The demo film for Steal This Vault, rendered from code with Remotion. Kept out of the root workspaces so the keeper's install stays small.

scripts.film: remotion render src/index.ts Film out/film-subtitled-picture.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --muted --gl=angle
scripts.film:clean: remotion render src/index.ts Film out/film-clean-picture.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --muted --gl=angle --props=clean-props.json
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts Main out/steal-this-vault-demo.mp4 --codec h264
scripts.preview: remotion render src/index.ts Main out/preview.mp4 --codec h264 --scale 0.5
